en._title: DGhostMarket — CS2 skin marketplace in Telegram
en._description: Buy and sell CS2 skins for Uzbek sum in Telegram. Payment is held until the item arrives, sellers are verified, 5% fee.
en._og_description: Safe CS2 skin deals: verified sellers, 24-hour transfer, payout after 8 days.
en.hero_title: Buy and sell CS2 skins for sum
en.hero_lead: DGhostMarket connects skin buyers and sellers. The platform holds the payment until the item reaches the buyer, and sellers verify their identity.
en.how_sub: The item moves directly between Steam accounts, while the platform watches the deadlines and holds the payment until the deal is complete.
en.b1: A catalog with filters by weapon, quality, float and price.
en.b2: With a method from the app. The platform holds the money — the seller doesn't get it yet.
en.b3: The seller sends a Steam trade within 24 hours. If not — you get a refund.
en.b4: Accept the trade in Steam and tap “Received”. Something wrong — open a dispute.
en.s1: Phone number via Telegram, a document photo and a selfie — once, before your first listing.
en.s2: Straight from your Steam inventory: photo, float and stickers are filled in automatically.
en.s3: After payment, send the Steam trade and mark it as “Sent”.
en.s4: 8 days after payment, the amount minus 5% lands on your balance. Card withdrawals are free.
en.fees_sub: No hidden charges: every amount is shown before you confirm.
en.fee_buyer_p: You pay the price on the listing. If a payment method charges a fee, the total is shown before payment.
en.fee_seller_p: The platform's fee on a sold item. It's the platform's only income from a deal.
en.fee_withdraw_p: From your balance to a bank card with no platform fee. Minimum — 50,000 sum.
en.safe_sub: Platform rules protect both sides: the buyer and the seller.
en.c1: Passport or ID, a selfie with the document and a phone number confirmed via Telegram. An admin makes the decision.
en.c2: Money is held for 8 days from payment — longer than Steam allows a trade to be reversed. Only then does it go to the seller.
en.c3: 24 hours to transfer the item. Miss it — the order is cancelled and the buyer is refunded.
en.c4: If the item doesn't arrive, the buyer opens a dispute. The payout is frozen until the admins sort it out.
en.c5: The system looks for linked accounts, reused numbers and suspicious deals. Stolen items mean a ban and frozen funds.
en.c6: Every step is recorded: payment, transfer, confirmation, payout. The history is always available in the app.
en.no_gambling: 🚫 DGhostMarket is a platform for deals between players. We don't run gambling, don't sell cases and don't accept bets. Giveaways are free: no payment is required to take part.
en.q1: What if the seller doesn't transfer the item?
en.a1: If within 24 hours of payment the seller hasn't marked the transfer and the item isn't in your Steam inventory, the order is cancelled automatically and you get your money back.
en.q2: Why does the seller get paid after 8 days?
en.a2: Steam allows a trade to be reversed within 7 days. The platform holds the payment a little longer so the buyer isn't left without the item, and the seller isn't left without the money.
en.q3: Do buyers need to get verified?
en.a3: No. Buyers just sign in with Telegram and add their Steam trade link. Only sellers get verified.
en.q4: Is the platform affiliated with Valve or Steam?
en.a4: No. DGhostMarket is an independent platform. Items move via standard Steam trades between users' accounts.
en.a5: Email support@dghostmarket.uz — we reply within 24 hours. For a specific deal, it's easiest to write from the app.
